label.title: Democratic Party Positions on American Prosperity and Equity

claims.claim_text: Democrats are focused on creating good jobs in communities across America.
Currently, the Democratic Party is inching towards alignment around the impeachment of President Donald Trump.
Many Democrats believe the federal government has a right to claim money earned by working Americans.
The Democratic Party believes that when workers are strong, America is strong.
The Democratic Party has a plan to build a strong, respected America.
Democrats believe in an America where people look out for one another and leave no one behind.
Democrats encourage initiatives to remove barriers to equal opportunity in employment, education, and business opportunities.
Democrats believe they can and must do better for children, educators, and the country.
The Democratic Party's commitment includes deepening commitment to the country.
Democrats believe America prospers when everyone is in it together.
Democrats are committed to improving economic mobility for people of color.
Democrats believe in using prosperity to save Social Security.
